f50.summary: Michel Le Tellier, secretary of state for war, warns Pierre de Marca, newly arrived in Barcelona as visitor general in Catalonia, that the Barcelona councillors chose for his lodgings the house of a friend of Marshal de La Motte, who hoped in that way to learn everything Marca does and writes; Barcelona's agent at court complains that the Catalans' packets are opened at La Motte's, and the Queen wishes Marca to watch this, report and stop it. Reading contributed by Harumi-Matsuba with Tomokiyo's key, AI-made and not yet checked by a person.
f50.en:
The councillors of the [city of] Barcelona, having ⟨p⟩ taken care to have a l⟨ϭ⟩ prepared for Monsieur de Marca,

system: Le Tellier-Marca cipher of 1644: a homophonic alphabet of figures 2-24, letters and invented signs, with overlined figures and letters for words and names (=3 de La Motte, =32 Barcelone, =11 =o la Reyne).
